description: XIRR (annualised return) on investments made on different dates, such as mutual fund SIP instalments, top-ups and withdrawals, from a list of dated transactions and the holding's current value. Same definition as Excel's XIRR (actual days / 365). Also returns total invested, withdrawn, gain and absolute return.

current_value.description: What the holding is worth now, in rupees (0 if fully withdrawn)

transactions.description: Each investment or withdrawal, in any order

type.description: invest = money put in; withdraw = money taken out (default invest)

value_date.description: Date of current_value as YYYY-MM-DD (default: today in India)

name: calculate_xirr
title: XIRR from dated transactions
